{"answer": "**What's wrong** The muted text announcing the riverfront path closure has a contrast ratio of 3.08:1 against its light background, but [SC 1.4.3] requires 4.5:1 for normal-sized text. The gray text is too faint to meet the legal minimum. **Who it affects** Anyone with low vision or reduced contrast sensitivity—including people with age-related vision loss or color blindness—will struggle to read this announcement. People relying on screen magnification will find the faint text particularly hard to distinguish from the background. **The fix** Change the text color from `rgb(138, 138, 138)` to a darker gray. Based on the light background `rgb(242, 242, 242)`, you need roughly `rgb(97, 97, 97)` or darker to hit 4.5:1. ```html

The riverfront path will be closed between Mill St and 4th Ave until 12 April.

``` Or update your `.muted` class CSS: ```css .muted { color: rgb(97, 97, 97); /* was rgb(138, 138, 138) */ } ``` Verify the exact color against `rgb(242, 242, 242)` in your contrast checker—you have a small margin, so test it visually too.", "tool_calls": 0}
